title: TFC Powder Melting
description: Makes Terrafirmacraft ore powders meltable with increased yield
body:
# TFC Powder Melting
Ever wanted to melt ore powders? Want to have a way to increase your ore yields? Would you like to have fine control over alloy concentrations? This datapack is for you!
## Features:
- All base TFC metal powders can now be smelted into 10mb of their respective metal with their accurate melting temperature.
- Metal powders heat up faster than ingots and raw ores.
- Metal powders can be placed in firepits, grills, charcoal forges and crucibles.
